title: Template not refreshed upon Build/reload
description:
When building/reinstalling package with an Rstudio project template, the template is not refreshed. Rebooting Rstudio does not work either, and neither does rebooting the computer. Pushing to Github and running devtools::install_github("mytemplatepackage") does work, but is very time consuming. Am I missing something?

Thank you for this feature!
